_about: Routing brain for the Owner Cell app. The app loads this and follows it; engine.py executes the steps. Edit numbers here as new runs measure them. Yields are per record entering the paid step. clean = mobile AND not DNC AND not litigator. Measured Sept 2026.

A.name: Scrape
A.when: The owner answers the business phone. Works in every US city.

steps.output: businesses with phone, maps link, rating, reviews

rules: keep only rows matching allowlist on category/subtypes/name

steps.keep: type == Mobile AND dnc == false AND tcpa == false (flag mode: keep dnc rows marked)

A.scale_rule: More cells = more cities. Never trace a Lane A record.

B.name: Name → home → trace
B.when: A receptionist answers, or there is no storefront. Needs a state with a name source AND an address source (see states).

steps.output: owner first/last (+ street if the licence file has it)

steps.skip_if: names already carry a home street (fl_re, fl_cpa)
rules: match owner string LAST FIRST% or FIRST LAST
exactly one owner → keep; two different owners → skip
street must have number + name + suffix; no suite/PO box

steps.keep: highest-score Mobile with dnc == false AND tcpa == false; keep email

B.scale_rule: More cells = more names. ~25% of names resolve to a home; ~45% of traces come back clean. 1,000 clean ≈ 2,200 traces ≈ 9,000 names.

C.name: Registry (phone already on file)
C.when: The state prints the licensee's own phone. Always check for this first — 10x cheaper.

steps.note: engine.trace verifies any record that already has a phone instead of tracing it

cpa.notes: FL file carries the home street — skip parcel. TX/AZ/GA/WA/TN have no CPA file with a name+address path.

property_manager.notes: PMs hold a broker licence; filter the broker file by business name (property mgmt / rental / leasing).

dentist.notes: NPPES is national; parcel step needs a state in states.parcel.

chiropractor.notes: Assumed = dentists. Measure on first run.

attorney.notes: Only ~13% of firms yield a traceable partner name. Never deliver from the Google scrape itself (2% mobile). Quote higher credits.

real_estate_investor.notes: Other states: pull the county owner file, group by owner, keep individuals with 3-8 parcels.

contractor_registry.notes: Sort newest licence first (85% mobile on 2020s licences vs 18% on 2000s).

pa_licensee.notes: PALS phone field = the person's own mobile 4/4. ~28% of rows carry one; the rest go through recipe B via Philadelphia OPA.

states._rule: Recipe A works in every state. Recipe B needs name_sources[industry] AND a parcel entry (or a licence file with a home street). Recipe C needs a registry with phone.

FL.parcel: statewide (times out some days — licence files carry the street anyway)
FL.notes: Best state. Direct trace from licence file.

NC.notes: NPPES + parcel proven for dentists, med spas, attorneys; investors grouping coded.

TX.parcel: Harris (HCAD bulk), Dallas (mirror), Travis (StratMap; per-county files exist for all TX)
TX.notes: TREC names + HCAD owner-occupied = 56% clean. No CPA file.

PA.notes: Allegheny hides owner names. PALS is per-surname search, not bulk — iterate common surnames.

GA.notes: No free realtor/CPA file (GREC sells one). Recipe A and investors only.

TN.notes: No licence downloads. Recipe A and investors only.

WA.notes: Contractors = recipe C. Professionals: no path.

CA.parcel: none — no owner names in any public product
CA.notes: Contractors = recipe C. Professionals: no path.

names: 7s5z-vewr (CPA, RE) — name + city only, no street
CO.notes: Needs a parcel source to be useful.

names: yg7h-zjbf real estate — business address only

states._other: Run free discovery first (Socrata catalog: api.us.socrata.com/api/catalog/v1?q=license&domains=<portal>; ArcGIS: arcgis.com/sharing/rest/search?q=parcels owner <state>). Add a row here when a path is verified. Until then: recipe A only.

guardrails: Check job credit cap BEFORE every paid call; on cap → deliver what exists, settle, stop.
Any HTTP error or unexpected body → stop the job, log the body, mark needs_attention. Never retry with another vendor.
Auto-sample ~20 cells first; if clean rate < 50% of expected → stop and refund the hold.
Recipe B: print/log 3 full addresses before the trace fires; drop any without number + street + suffix.
Never call BatchData property search. Never scrape Google for attorneys/CPAs/med spas as the deliverable.
Dedupe against delivered (per user) and suppression (global) before delivery. Re-scrub after 31 days.
Never emit landline/VoIP. Litigator (tcpa) rows are dropped in every mode.
